selections.name: go-api-contracts
selections.reason: The task implements exported methods/functions, JSON publication, sentinel errors and existing/new process contracts. Preserve function types, old Put semantics and CLI status/streams.

selections.name: go-core-style
selections.reason: All implementation and regression-test work is Go; use simple standard-library code, early error handling, owned state and Go1.22-compatible APIs.

selections.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
selections.reason: Refresh borrows a supplied HTTP client/context and owns response bodies; Serve owns callback/release ordering, recurrence and cooperative cancellation; the CLI owns its client transport and signals.

selections.name: go-package-boundaries
selections.reason: The package acquires CSV ingestion, snapshot fetching/publication and refresh lifecycle responsibilities. Existing stubs and the current command already identify the consumers. Keep cohesive library operations in the existing package and host signals/configuration in cmd/indexer; no package split or interface is justified.

selections.name: go-test-isolation
selections.reason: The tests own temporary files, HTTP servers, process environment, subprocesses, callback gates, goroutines and timing observations. Use independent paths, explicit events, cancellation/join cleanup and bounded checks.

reference_relevance.go-test-isolation/references/isolation-p: Needed Go1.22 event/timing choices, parallel subtest fixture lifetime, focused selection and faithful HTTP/process boundaries.
